facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics of South Sudan's Laws & Policies page lists the National Bureau of Statistics Act, 2024 as the principal legislation establishing the Bureau and defining its mandate, functions and authority; the page is undated, so its capture date 2026-08-29 is the published date, and the year 2024 is the Act's.

Eye Radio reports that the Vice President's Office deputy press secretary named the National Bureau of Statistics Act 2024 as one of two key documents the Bureau's Director General raised in a briefing on 2025-09-15/16; the report gives no date for the Act's making and the briefing is not an act under it.

systems.system: National Strategy for Development of Statistics 2014-2020

note: The strategy lists a revised Statistical Act as an objective (developing legislation) but states no law in force, no published draft and no dated step.

facts.fact: The NBS chair told Radio Tamazuj that the statistics bill was passed in July 2024; assent and promulgation are not stated.

The Director General of South Sudan's National Bureau of Statistics says the National Parliament recently passed the National Statistics Bill (year left blank), legally grounding the Bureau's mandate; nothing says it was promulgated.

note: SPI 5.1.1 is a compliance score with no named law; states no fact.

facts.fact: One Citizen Daily reports South Sudan's Transitional National Legislative Assembly unanimously passed the National Bureau of Statistics Bill 2024 at third reading, awaiting presidential assent, to repeal the 2011 statistics act.
